verdict.rationale: Smithery's earlier docs described connecting to MCP servers and calling their tools: a REST Connect interface, `smithery mcp add <url>`, `smithery tool call`, and aggregating tools across servers. Its own shutdown notice says the Smithery API, Connect, Toolbox, CLI and SDKs stopped working on October 31, 2026. Smithery now remains only as a non-proxied registry, which cannot plug in servers or use their tools, so the product no longer delivers this applicable capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
